title: Audit Legacy REST APIs, Generate Missing Unit Tests & Fix Edge Cases
oneLiner: Feed old backend routes to an agent to automatically generate 100% test coverage, spot subtle null-pointer edge cases, and produce safe refactoring diffs.
problem: Solo developers maintain legacy backend endpoints written months ago without unit tests. Making even minor changes feels risky because unseen side-effects could break production.
workflow: Pointed the coding agent to a legacy controller file and its data schema.
Instructed the agent to write comprehensive edge-case test suites using Jest/PyTest.
The agent caught 2 unhandled database timeout cases and a null-parameter crash, then submitted a clean pull request.
prompt:
You are a senior principal backend engineer with a zero-tolerance policy for flaky code. Review the following API route file:
[PASTE ROUTE / CONTROLLER CODE HERE]

Do the following:
1. Threat & Bug Analysis: Highlight any unhandled exceptions, race conditions, missing input sanitization, or unindexed database queries.
2. Write a comprehensive test suite covering:
   - Happy path (valid inputs & expected response codes).
   - Boundary and edge cases (empty strings, negative numbers, extreme character counts).
   - Error scenarios (database timeouts, malformed auth headers).
3. Propose a minimal, surgical code diff that fixes all identified vulnerabilities without breaking existing client contracts.

realityCheck.firstTryMistake: The agent initially mocked out external services too aggressively, masking an actual SQL syntax issue.
realityCheck.manualCleanupTime: About 4 minutes to run the test suite locally and verify mocks matched the real database behavior.
realityCheck.limitations: Always run tests in an isolated staging sandbox before deploying to production servers.
